integrity: Exact algebraic uniqueness and normalized monotonicity proved; 72 independent numeric parameter cases and symbolic checks replayed. Equatorial QFIM and reset renewal are explicitly credited prior facts.
scientific_limitations: Stationary fully re-prepared single qubit, known Poisson rate, Markov pure dephasing, joint unknown frequency and dephasing, local single-copy SLD information determinant only. No time-cost or finite-sample measurement claim.
title: Unique joint-sensing reset optimum for a dephased qubit
